column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each financial record (e.g., 'FIN0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), tying finances to a specific event (e.g., 'DIST0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing Operations(OpsRegistry), linking finances to operations (e.g., 'OPS0001').
A DECIMAL(16,3) for the allocated budget in USD (e.g., 1000000.000).
A DECIMAL(7,3) measuring percentage of utilized funds (e.g., 75.500).
A NUMERIC(14,3) capturing the cost per beneficiary in USD (e.g., 15.250).
A DECIMAL(15,2) describing total operational costs (e.g., 350000.00).
A DECIMAL(15,4) enumerating personnel costs in USD (e.g., 50000.0000).
An enum (FundingState_enum) labeling funding status; values: 'Critical', 'Adequate', 'Limited'.
A DECIMAL(14,2) representing pledged donor funds (e.g., 200000.00).
An INT recording the gap in resources needed (e.g., 50000).
